requirements.quote: **No user-facing dimension or filter by individual judge or bench composition**, enforced in the user-facing query and API layer with a static test.
`packages/intelligence/src/analytics/`: aggregates by forum, case type, stage and period (listing delay, adjournments per hearing, time to disposal, backlog).
Internal stores may hold bench-level data (D-050); the user-facing layer can't read them, except through the separate, flagged `bench_facts` surface.
Privacy: aggregates only, with a minimum cell size (k-anonymity threshold) and no party data.
`apps/web`: a court insights page per forum and case type
and expected timelines on a matter.
requirements.why: Needs a per-matter lookup from the matter's forum and case type into the aggregates plus a matter-detail UI change; separate work once the aggregates exist and the page is proven. The aggregate core delivered here is reusable for it.

#487 (public developer API with quotas) was closed not_planned, so no institution API, key scoping or quota framework exists to build on; the endpoints also need the cross-workspace aggregation and counsel review that this change does not do.

requirements.quote: A static test fails if any user-facing analytics query, column or API parameter refers to a judge or bench member. [type:unit]
Cells below the minimum size are suppressed. [type:unit]
A forum and case-type page shows median listing delay, adjournment rate and time to disposal, with the data window and coverage stated. [type:integration]

deliverables.change: Export MIN_CELL_SIZE (5), a pure summariseCells(rows, {minCell}) that returns median listing delay, adjournment rate, median time to disposal and backlog per forum x case type x stage x period, with values null and suppressed:true when n < MIN_CELL_SIZE; plus getCourtInsights(tx, {forumId?, caseTypeCode?, from, to}) that reads proceeding, listing, hearing and proceeding_state_change inside the caller's RLS transaction and returns cells plus window {from,to} and coverage {proceedings, hearings}. Must not select listing.bench_id, hall_id, bench or judge columns, party titles, or any bench_sitting_fact / board table.

Unit tests: medians, adjournment rate, suppression below MIN_CELL_SIZE and at the boundary (n = 5 shown, n = 4 suppressed), no cell carries a suppressed value; one DB-backed test if the package already has a DB test harness, otherwise a fake tx.

Static guard modelled on bench-facts/static-guard.test.ts: comment-stripped scan of the analytics source, the insights page and its component, and the court-insights i18n keys for /judge|bench|justice|coram|petitioner|respondent|party/i (judge, bench and party fields), with a planted-offender mutation case. Also asserts the analytics query file never references the bench_sitting_fact, board_observation or bench schema objects.

Server page: require the workspace context, gate on can(ctx,'insights.read') (PermissionDeniedPage otherwise), read forum and caseType from searchParams, call getCourtInsights inside withWorkspace, render the component. No judge or bench filter or parameter.

Table of cells: median listing delay, adjournment rate and median time to disposal per forum x case type, 'not enough data' for suppressed cells, and a footer stating the data window and coverage counts. Add a test in apps/web/components/courts/__tests__/court-insights.test.tsx covering values, suppressed cell and window/coverage text.

New namespace court-insights with the page strings. Add the same keys to ta and kn (mirror files), regenerate generated messages (pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n i18n:types), update translation-status.json if the checker requires it, and register the namespace in packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts.
Add an Insights link to the courts nav to the new route, only if the nav lists sibling courts pages; otherwise leave unchanged and drop this deliverable.
Short doc: metric definitions, the MIN_CELL_SIZE rule, own-workspace scope, the guard, and the deferred items.

preserve.what: bench-facts guard and surfaces stay unchanged: packages/intelligence/src/bench-facts/*, packages/core/src/court-day/bench-card.ts, apps/api/src/routes/v1/bench-card.ts.
The /w/[slug]/insights placeholder page and its nav item (apps/web/lib/nav.ts:108, apps/web/__tests__/nav.test.ts) keep working; the new page is a separate route under courts/insights.
No change to @causedeck/core runtime exports, so packages/db/src/testing/cross-tenant-registry.ts needs no entry; no new table, so no migration or RLS catalog change.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/intelligence exec vitest run src/analytics src/bench-facts src/index.test.ts

decisions.choice: Aggregate only the caller's own workspace data (RLS scope) instead of cross-workspace network aggregates.
decisions.justification: The source tables are tenant tables under FORCE RLS (packages/db/src/schema/docket.ts:38, proceedings.ts:40); cross-tenant aggregation needs an owner-defined function like app_bench_* (bench-facts.ts:1-9) and a privacy/counsel decision that D-050 reserves; own-workspace keeps R4 satisfiable with a cell-size floor.

decisions.choice: Copy the comment-stripped regex static guard with a mutation case.
decisions.justification: packages/intelligence/src/bench-facts/static-guard.test.ts:12-45 is the repo's established way to pin a D-050 prohibition.

decisions.choice: The new page is courts/insights, not the /insights placeholder.
decisions.justification: /insights is the practice-insights slot gated by insights.read (apps/web/lib/nav.ts:108); court analytics is a courts concern and a static segment beats courts/[code].
